parts.name: VoiceGlow
parts.description: A surface whose bottom edge lights up with a voice. It draws the card itself (border, radius and background) and puts the light behind its content. An `Input` or `Textarea` placed directly inside loses its own border and background, and the surface shows that field's focus ring.

props.name: state
props.description: `listening` and `speaking` raise the light with `level`. `processing` sweeps it from side to side. `idle` turns it off.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the surface: a field, a row of buttons, a transcript.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the element. A Tailwind size such as `size-24` or a text color such as `text-primary` overrides the defaults.

cssVariables.name: --voice-level
cssVariables.description: The level the light follows, set from the `level` prop.
